lines.text: SEAL GAS SYSTEM (HC GAS PRIMARY & N2
LUBE OIL RESERVOIR VENT. OIL MIST SEPERATOR INSTALLED OFF-SKID.
HIGH POINT VENT AND LOW POINT DRAIN TO BE FINALIZED BY PIPING AS PER PIPING
OIL CHANGE BY USING TEMPORARY ARRANGEMENT WITH HOSES.
FLAME ARRESTER INCLUDES FLAME FILTER AND LOCATED AT END OF PIPE.
MANUAL DRAIN PRIOR TO START-UP. PUSH BUTTON WITH PERMISSIVE TO START
COMPRESSOR MOTOR EQUIPPED WITH VARIABLE SPEED DRIVE (VSD). FOR VSD
MONITORING AND TRIP FUNCTION, REFER VENDOR DRAWING NO.
(0D204-CIT-P-XB-ER252A-000002-002). VSD NOT IN COMPRESSOR VENDOR SCOPE.
UPSTREAM STRAIGHT PIPE RUN MIN. 10xD, DOWNSTREAM MIN 5xD.
PRIMARY SEAL GAS IS TAKEN DOWNSTREAM LAST COMPRESSING STAGE (4TH
SECONDARY SEAL GAS AND SEPARATION GAS.
ANTI-SURGE CONTROL (ASC) AND PRESSURE CONTROL (PIC3-GE) BY UCP.
COMPRESSOR SUCTION PRESSURE IS CONTROLLED BY USING VSD; DISCHARGE
SUCTION STRAINER (COMMISSIONING PHASE ONLY) WITH STRAIGHT PIPE RUNS
MIN. 5xD UPSTREAM AND 2xD DOWNSTREAM TO AVOID DAMAGE DUE TO
TURBULENCE. HIGH ALARM AT 40 % OF DESIGN DP AND COMPRESSOR
HIGH-HIGH TRIP AT 50 % OF DESIGN DP RECOMMENDED BY COMPRESSOR
INSULATION THICKNESS TO BE TAKEN INTO CONSIDERATION ON TW SELECTION.
DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE BASED ORIFICE TYPE VOLUME FLOW METER.
DESIGN PRESSURE / TEMPERATURE IN EXTERNAL SYSTEM DOWNSTREAM
FROM SEAL GAS SYSTEM RUPTURE DISCS.
BOTTOM ENTRY FOR SUCTION AND DISCHARGE NOZZLES.
FOR COMPRESSOR, GEAR AND MOTOR VIBRATION AND TEMPERATURE
MONITORING AND TRIP FUNCTION FUNCTION, REFER VENDOR DRAWING NOS.
COMPRESSOR SUCTION PRESSURE TO PDIT FOR PRIMARY SEAL GAS.
POWER AT COMPRESSOR COUPLING FOR MAX CAMBO CASE.
MAX CAMBO -CASE. CORRESPONDING VOL. FLOW 66 MMSCFD / 1.87 MSm3/d.
SAFETY CRITICAL HEAT TRACING - HYDRATE MITIGATION (25°C).
32.    LL SET POINT IS OVERRIDEN AT START-UP.
PROVISION FOR FUTURE HOT GAS BYPASS LINE.
